capabilities: Detect paper URLs in modified Markdown files
Resolve paper metadata from Semantic Scholar, arXiv, Crossref, and OpenAlex
Download open-access PDFs into the vault
Refresh citation counts on a schedule or on demand
Generate a Mermaid paper map for the current note
extras: Sends paper identifiers, URLs, and titles to public metadata services (though not full note content); inserts managed blocks between HTML comments and saves PDFs to a papers/ folder by default; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to resolve paper URLs into metadata, download open-access PDFs, or track citation counts inside notes.

relations.evidence: Resolves metadata from Semantic Scholar, arXiv, Crossref, OpenAlex, and citation meta tags.
Citation counts prefer Semantic Scholar. If Semantic Scholar is rate limited, OpenAlex and Crossref are used as fallbacks.
